feature.goal: frame-based professor animation for the lecture scene
notes: The background and stage must remain visually calm and mostly static.
The animation should feel like a lightweight 3D cartoon lecture mascot, not a floating UI sticker.
Use multiple transparent PNG frames and swap them in JavaScript.
Keep the camera angle, scale, and silhouette stable between frames.
Do not generate speech bubbles or stage elements inside the character PNG.

global_constraints: same face, outfit, camera angle, and head-to-body ratio across all frames
big head, cute chibi body, Korean Trevor-like playful professor energy
navy cardigan or blazer, white shirt, warm tie, khaki or neutral pants, brown shoes
soft 3D render, not flat illustration, not photorealistic

animation_sets.usage: default waiting pose while no new line is being spoken
active explanation while a new dialogue line is on screen
